items.title: Tools and Platforms for Real-Time Collaboration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Tools and Platforms for Real-Time Collaboration (PDF 129, printed 125).

blocks.text: Real-time collaboration tools kai users ko ek hi waqt mein ek hi project par kaam karne dete hain. Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams aur Zoom jaise platforms documents share karna, chat karna aur online meeting karna aasan banate hain. Yeh tools teams ko kaam munazzam karne, files mil kar edit karne aur foran update rehne mein madad dete hain. Real-time collaboration sab ko ek page par rakh kar waqt bachata aur ghaltiyan kam karta hai. In platforms ka achha istemal teams ko digital mahol mein tez aur behtar kaam karne deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Real-time collaboration ka kya matlab hai? Do platforms ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation: Kai users aik hi waqt mein aik hi project par kaam karte hain aur tabdeeliyan foran sab ko nazar aati hain. Platforms: Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, Zoom.

items: Real-time tools: aik saath editing, chat aur meetings.
Waqt bachate aur ghaltiyan kam karte hain kyunke sab aik page par rehte hain.
